title: Il rilascio del permesso di soggiorno
notes: National source (Polizia di Stato): apply within 8 working days of entry, to the Questura (some permits via post offices), documents, average 60 days, contribution. Page dated 24/06/2014, modified 05/01/2024. Article element only.

title: Permesso di soggiorno: come, dove e quanto costa
notes: National source (Polizia di Stato): where to apply (post office kit, Patronati, Comuni, Sportello Unico; otherwise only the Questura), costs, the post office receipt, the Questura appointment for fingerprints. Page dated 07/04/2014, modified 18/04/2019. The article text on the site ends mid-sentence. Article element only.

title: Il Codice Fiscale - Che cos'è e come si ottiene
notes: National source (Agenzia delle Entrate): for foreigners applying for a permit the code is assigned by the Questura (or by the Sportello Unico for work/family entry); first code for foreigners requires an in-person appointment. 'Ultimo aggiornamento: 7 marzo 2025'. Article element only.

title: Take Residence in Milano (YesMilano, International Student Desk)
notes: The City's information path for international students named in the hackathon brief (YesMilano / Milano&Partners). English. Documents, the online platform, 45-day check with home visit, 20-day and 60-day update duties. The site sometimes answers 403 to repeated requests; fetched with browser headers. Article element only.

title: Get Your Residence Permit (YesMilano, International Student Desk)
notes: Student path (English): apply within 8 working days of arrival, post office kit, receipt as proof of legal stay, police appointment. For amounts use the national sources (permesso-soggiorno, permesso-soggiorno-come). Article element only.

title: Get Your Tax Code (YesMilano, International Student Desk)
notes: Student path (English): tax code only after arrival, Agenzia delle Entrate appointment, form AA4/8 signed by pen. First article element only.
